entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.current_evidence: Ordered secondary index metadata is parsed and release-gated as unsafe until ordered keys are complete; query execution scans base rows when ordered index keys are missing.
entries.missing_evidence: Accepted ordered-composite access paths still need durable metadata for index element clauses, table-generation ownership, validation state, and promotion state before the planner can trust them.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows query ignores ordered secondary indexes and scans base rows

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.current_evidence: Secondary-index rebuild work ranges are durable, workers can repair and finish ranges, and stale ready rebuild generations are ignored during promotion.
entries.missing_evidence: Ordered-composite and expression-derived rebuild and promotion still need to route through the same generation/CAS lifecycle as ordinary secondary indexes with release-gated promotion evidence.
entries.evidence_symbol: secondary index promotion ignores stale ready rebuild generation

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.current_evidence: Queries ignore building secondary indexes and scan base rows when matching index keys are incomplete; semantic implication inventory also tracks unsafe ordered and partial-predicate paths.
entries.missing_evidence: Stale, building, unvalidated, or partially promoted derived artifacts still need explicit proof that they cannot affect query answers, uniqueness enforcement, FK enforcement, or upsert conflict selection.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows query ignores building secondary indexes and scans base rows
